the 25th of September.
That match brought an end to the CG Cardinals' undefeated streak of four of their last five games in the league this season, and they faced another loss as Liversedge lost 5-1 to Albion Sports midweek, concluding another run of solid home performance in the Premier Division.
They had only lost one game in five away from home prior to Saturday's defeat and in fact Liversedge had not lost at Albion Park for several seasons.
Thus, during this season's visit, the momentum shifted, allowing the Albion Sports fans to rejoice as their team secured a 5-1 victory, with Thomas Graham scoring a hat-trick for the Skelmersdale side.
They are one of the form sides in the league and currently third on the table and a victory or even a draw would have extended their unbeaten home record for the season to 15-0.
Both sides came into the game in decent recent form but unfortunately it was the Albion Sports who were buoyant going into the game.
Without midweek games on Thursday, Lee Jackson's team had their first chance to relax since the drawn FA Cup match against Ossett Town. It’s clear that both the players and staff regretted their half-term trip to Tenerife after they thoroughly dived into an intense session on Saturday.
Liversedge realized they were facing an outstanding team on Saturday and, while expecting a tough test, entered the match believing they had the ability to handle them.
The hosts entered the match having lost closely to Kendal and drawn 0-0 against Garforth, while it's worth remembering that Liversedge had only suffered one defeat in their last four matches.
They started the match well on a dry and sunny afternoon on the Spekel Lathom for the clash. Liversedge had a bright start and could have went a couple of goal up in the early stages.
In the 8th minute, Joseph Davis' shot was cleared off the line after the goalkeeper advanced from his position, resulting in a near goal attempt that missed scoring his first of the season.
